About AB Fitness Gym

More Than A Workout.

A place to train with purpose, build discipline, and become stronger — one session at a time.

AB FITNESS GYM is built around a simple idea — training should be consistent, focused, and personal.

Whether someone is stepping into a gym for the first time or working toward a stronger version of themselves, the focus is on proper guidance, disciplined training, and steady progress.

Our Philosophy

Discipline Over Motivation.

01
Consistency

Progress is built through showing up, training regularly, and staying committed.

02
Proper Training

Learn the fundamentals, train with control, and focus on doing each movement correctly.

03
Personal Guidance

Every member deserves clear guidance and a training approach that matches their goals and experience.

One Gym. One Trainer. One Focused Approach.

A personal training environment where members can learn, train, and stay accountable under direct guidance.

Free Tools

Know Your Numbers.

Estimate your daily calories and water intake in seconds.

Calorie Maintenance Calculator

Find your BMR and daily calories (TDEE) for maintenance, fat loss and muscle gain.

Please enter a valid age (15–90), height (100–250 cm) and weight (25–300 kg).

Your BMR: 0 kcal/day

Maintenance 0 kcal/day
Fat Loss 0 kcal/day
Muscle Gain 0 kcal/day

Calculated with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. Fat loss = maintenance − 500 kcal (about 0.5 kg per week); muscle gain = maintenance + 300 kcal. These are estimates, not medical advice.

Daily Water Intake Calculator

Estimate how much water you need each day based on your body and training.

Please enter a valid weight (25–300 kg) and workout time (0–300 min).

0.00 L

0 ml per day

Daily Target 0 glasses of 250 ml
Reminder 0 ml every hour

Based on roughly 30–40 ml of water per kg of body weight (adjusted for activity) plus about 350 ml per 30 minutes of exercise. Needs vary with climate and health — this is an estimate, not medical advice.
